scope: 89 previously inspected pairs /46 RGB source groups; cached DINO224 features from mac-02; no new confirmation inputs, model downloads, training, GPU or paid resources
question: Does source region choice or radius2 position constraint account for the observed B3 deficit?
annotation: Assistant visually proposes rectangular source regions from source-only contact sheets of all46 groups. No edited images or labels on annotation sheets. Reviewer knows earlier aggregate and disagreement results: not independent blinded expert annotation, ground truth segmentation, or a mathematical upper bound.
region_coordinates: One or more boxes in cropped DINO16x16 patch-grid coordinates; select patches whose centers lie within any box, union without duplicates. Freeze annotation JSON and SHA before computing new pair scores.
unclear_source_policy: If no defensible standalone preserved source object can be drawn, explicitly flag scene_ambiguous and fall back to all256 patches for the full89 diagnostic. Separately report pre-scoring source-eligible subset; no outcome-based exclusions.
matched_area_controls: For reviewed region K, also take U2NETP topK probabilities, source CLS salient topK, random K, center K; exactly identical K in each group, same support for A/B. U2NETP threshold support remains legacy replay only.
correspondence: Unchanged source-to-candidate maximum cosine then source-region mean; unrestricted or Chebyshev radius2 on16x16 grid. No radius or annotation tuning after scores.
metrics: Same expert preferences as mac-02; tie0.5; illegal0; report full89, source-eligible subset, unclear-source subset, fixes/newerrors, source-group paired bootstrap4000 seed20261120. Source-group counts and subgroup sample sizes explicit.
correspondence_diagnostic: For source selected patches log fraction of unrestricted NN argmax displacements outside radius2 and score penalty from restricting positions. These are feature matches, not verified physical correspondences or causal labels.
decision: Retain B1 as strongest observed baseline unless diagnostic supports a mechanism worth independently validating. Any improvement on reused diagnostic pairs is not a new confirmation result or sufficient novelty claim.
deliverables: New local run with source review, frozen supports, per-pair scores, paired summaries, failures and QA; publish allowed code/configs/summary/screened pair metrics only under foreground-fidelity/. Update Word only if the resulting research decision changes materially.
